title: Cham Islands in a day
budget: 70,000 VND visit fee. The boat is check on arrival.
summary: The morning boats leave Cửa Đại for Hòn Lao. Walk to Hải Tạng if the return will wait, and eat the catch in Bai Lang. Crossing minutes were not printed, so this day has no timed stops.

days.title: The boat, the ridge, and Hải Tạng
days.body: The 30 August 2023 pier report describes passengers from 08:00, with the crowd from 08:00 to 10:00. Land at Bai Lang. Hải Tạng is the walk above Đồng Chùa. The 15 September 2025 study puts lunch around 11:00–12:00. The visit fee is 70,000 VND a person from 10 June 2026. The boat fare and the minutes on the water are check on arrival.

seoTitle: Cham Islands in a day — boat from Cửa Đại
seoDescription: A landing day on Hòn Lao from the Cửa Đại pier. The visit fee is 70,000 VND from 10 June 2026. The boat fare and the crossing minutes are check on arrival.
